description: Digital Asset Inheritance & Ownership platform — tools for crypto estate planning, asset discovery, and regulatory compliance (BGH, MiCA, BaFin).

subProjects.note: DAIO is a mono-directory with 14+ sub-projects. Publish strategy options:
options: Option A: Single repo with all sub-projects (simplest)
Option B: DAIO-Unified as main repo, others as separate repos
Option C: Only publish Commander MVP and Wallet as showcase
subProjects.recommended: Option B — DAIO-Unified aggregates 9 apps, Commander MVP is standalone

prePushChecklist: CRITICAL: Wallet projects contain crypto code — audit for real private keys or mnemonics
Commander MVP has Electron build config — exclude signing certificates and installer output
Verify no MySQL/PostgreSQL credentials in daio-wallet server configs
Template Generator may have client-specific DOCX templates — remove before publish
Archive/ and duplicate folders (Template Generator App (1)) should be excluded
ZIP files in directory should NOT be committed
Global Loss Estimator numbers (47B EUR) are public claims — OK to publish
Remove any Kimi_Agent prefixes from folder names if publishing
